_note: From docs/sources/Kalki_Purana_Game_Reference.pdf section 6 (research edition 1.0, 9 Oct 2026). Source tags: A=Bhagavata/Vishnu/Agni, B=Kalki Purana expanded account, G=game adaptation. Playable design, encounters and abilities are G. Order: M00..M17 (M09 is codex-first).

missions.title: The Age Fractures
missions.scriptural_event: Explore moral collapse, save refugees, witness corrupt kings.
missions.encounters: Corrupt officials, raiders by deed; not identity groups.
missions.integrity_gate: World-state levels pre-planned; symbolic UI for truth, safety, protection.

missions.title: The House in Shambhala
missions.playable_design: Home village traversal, family interactions, early dharma themes.
missions.integrity_gate: Do not claim Shambhala is a known modern city.

missions.title: Parashurama's Gurukula
missions.scriptural_event: Study Vedas, arts and Dhanurveda with Parashurama.
missions.playable_design: Melee tutorial, archery, nonlethal practice, scripted lessons.
missions.integrity_gate: Revalidate any earlier Parashurama model import (rig and licence).

missions.title: Three Gifts of Mahadeva
missions.scriptural_event: Worship Shiva; obtain horse, Shuka parrot, jewel-hilted sword.
missions.playable_design: Devotional approach, equipping gear, mounted movement trial.
missions.integrity_gate: Mahadeva appears solely as the revered giver of the three gifts.

missions.title: The Parrot of Simhala
missions.scriptural_event: Meet Vishakhayupa; learn of Padma; messenger exchanges.
missions.integrity_gate: Scout mode is an adaptation, not in the Purana.

missions.title: The Lotus of Simhala
missions.scriptural_event: Cross to Simhala; meet Padma; wedding and restoration.
missions.playable_design: Travel, ceremonies, city visit, ritual choreography.
missions.integrity_gate: Respect Padma agency and text version.

missions.title: The Teaching of Ananta
missions.scriptural_event: Discussion of Maya, devotion and liberation.
missions.playable_design: Short interactive parable/vision with clear paraphrase labels.
missions.integrity_gate: Sage Ananta is not automatically Sheshanaga.

missions.title: Return to Shambhala
missions.scriptural_event: Return with Padma; meet family; prepare campaign.
missions.integrity_gate: No grinding as a replacement for story.

missions.title: The Disputed Kikata Narrative
missions.scriptural_event: Later text conflict and subsequent spiritual teaching.
missions.playable_design: Textual codex and moral dialogue; optional battle against identified violent aggressors, labelled ADAPTATION.
missions.encounters: Do not assign hostile alignment from Buddhist, Jain, ethnic, caste or other present-day identities.
missions.integrity_gate: Later sectarian content; label adaptation clearly. Codex-only is acceptable.

missions.title: The Giantess of the North
missions.scriptural_event: Rishis request help; overcome Kuthodari and Vikanja.
missions.playable_design: Mountain riding, huge creature battle, brahmastra finale.
missions.encounters: Demonic entities named in the source.

missions.title: Two Dynasties Await
missions.scriptural_event: Discover Maru and Devapi; hear Suryavamsa and Chandravamsa.
missions.playable_design: Quest for alliances; lore visualizer; twin chariot gifts.

missions.title: Dharma Without a Throne
missions.scriptural_event: Dharma appears in distress; Krita personified; march on Visasana.
missions.playable_design: Army formation planning with cinematic escort.
missions.integrity_gate: Do not turn historical people labels into monster species.

missions.title: The Siege of Kali
missions.playable_design: Multi-stage war; mounted combat; duo-boss fight; public safety objectives.
missions.integrity_gate: Source supports war/characters, not exact boss phases (twin-revive rule is G).

missions.title: The King Who Recognized Him
missions.scriptural_event: Confront Shashidhvaja; defeat to reconciliation; Shushanta intervenes.
missions.playable_design: Honourable duel, dramatic captivity scene, peace dialogue.
missions.integrity_gate: Kalki fainting is textual; avoid framing as casual player death.

missions.title: The City of the Poison Curse
missions.scriptural_event: Kalki enters Kanchanapuri alone; Sulocana is released.
missions.playable_design: No-kill puzzle/exploration and rescue with Devadatta and Shuka.
missions.integrity_gate: One of the clearest mercy-centred chapters.

missions.title: The Throne Is Restored
missions.scriptural_event: Maru, Devapi and others receive duties; rituals and healing of society.
missions.playable_design: Restoration states for towns, reforms, festivals, renunciation of abuse.
missions.integrity_gate: Restoration is the mandatory win condition.

missions.title: Dawn of Krita Yuga
missions.scriptural_event: Dharma returns; farewell and Vishnu form; Satya Yuga dawns.
missions.playable_design: Long-form ending cinematics; nonviolent epilogue; codex completion.
missions.integrity_gate: Keep variant departure details in an optional tradition appendix.
